# coolify_hetzner_firewalls (Data Source)

Lists existing Hetzner Cloud firewalls for a given cloud provider token. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_hetzner_firewalls" "all" {
  cloud_provider_token_uuid = coolify_cloud_token.hetzner.uuid
}

output "hetzner_firewall_names" {
  value = [for fw in data.coolify_hetzner_firewalls.all.firewalls : fw.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) The UUID of the cloud provider token to use for listing Hetzner firewalls.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `firewalls` (Attributes List) The list of Hetzner firewalls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewalls))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--firewalls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewalls`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The numeric Hetzner firewall ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the firewall.
